brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: Build contains exactly one piece: piece:0,0,0;half-n (checked via get_build total=1, counts piece=1). No additional cells beside or on level 1.

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: get_build shows only the single base, no neighboring pieces at level 0 and no piece at 0,0,1. All piece sockets s10-s15 remain empty.

Configurator offers at most 1 drawer per half-base (find_sockets drawer returned 1 socket s9 for half-n, 1 for half-s, 0 for full/half-e/half-w/quarter variants). Tested all base variants; none offers 5 drawers. Current build has 0 drawers (drawer:0#0,0#cut removed). A full hex base offers 0 drawer sockets; half bases offer 1. Five drawers cannot be placed in a single hex cell under current placement rules.

finish.summary: Build retains a single hex base (half-n) with no adjacent or stacked pieces as requested, but the five-drawer requirement is unmet: the configurator's socket system allows maximum 1 drawer in a half-base and 0 in a full base, making 5 drawers in one cell impossible.
